profile.name: SUGANTHAN M
profile.title: Full-Stack Software Engineer & React Specialist
profile.tagline: Specialized in Full-Stack Web Development, React.js, Node.js & Scalable Cloud Solutions.
profile.bio: I am SUGANTHAN M, a Full-Stack Software Engineer based in Chennai, Tamil Nadu with 2 years of practical experience engineering scalable web applications and responsive user interfaces. With strong foundations in modern JavaScript (ES6+), React.js, Node.js, Express, and REST architectures, I specialize in translating complex architectural requirements into elegant, high-performance web systems with fluid interactivity.

projects.title: Interactive Full-Stack Web Application
projects.description: Full-featured web platform featuring real-time UI interactivity, dynamic API feeds, and responsive dark aesthetics.
projects.longDescription: Engineered a production-ready application using modular Express REST APIs on the backend and modern vanilla JavaScript with reactive component patterns on the frontend. Features asynchronous CRUD operations, instant search and categorization, and persistent storage.

projects.title: AI Cloud Analytics Dashboard
projects.description: Real-time interactive data visualization platform with AI metrics tracking, user filtering, and responsive metrics.
projects.longDescription: Architected an analytics dashboard delivering aggregated statistics, visual progress indicators, and fast querying across complex dataset categorizations.

projects.title: High-Throughput Microservice API
projects.description: Scalable RESTful microservice with dual-mode storage, JSON/MongoDB adapters, and strict input validation.
projects.longDescription: Built robust backend endpoints supporting pagination, regex search, schema validation, and health checks with zero-downtime database fallback.
